mesh_rule.mesh_drag_source: Harmonic Drive CSF/CSG catalogue printed p. 46, Table 38: maximum no-load starting torque, CSF-14 housed unit, ratio 50, 4.1 N cm (sibling value; none published for the HSS-14)
mesh_rule.brake_model: Passive PhysX friction contacts; capacity rises with measured axial load. Diagnostic drag_est is not actual measured torque; no external torque.
mesh_rule.press_source: 10-30 N obtained by live chat from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026); minimum feed requires lower end 10 N
mesh_rule.overload_status: 30 N benchmark limit, not a bearing damage rating
mesh_rule.force_measurement: PhysX detailed wg/stop axial normal impulse divided by 1/240 s; touching separation <=0.05 mm. Whole-trial 0.25 s time-weighted sum of axial normal and friction component magnitudes on wg/stop and wg/base paths, independent of offset/tilt. No force inferred from spring deflection.

runout_check.derivation: flexspline teeth 2 x 50 = 100 (two-tooth difference, assumed); pitch diameter about 35 mm (estimate) gives module about 0.35 mm; one-tooth jump offsets generator between about one module and one tooth height, 0.35-0.7 mm, giving roughly 0.7-1.4 mm two-turn shaft runout; shaft response is unknown. The 0.3 mm cutoff is under half the low end and at least three times the enrolled baseline.
runout_check.status: derived estimate; not verified on a physical specimen
runout_check.indicator_model_status: ARVONELLE 0-10 mm dial indicator with magnetic base, 0.01 mm divisions, $54.99 displayed; stock status must be confirmed; contact force unmeasured
